body: core sync.ts isNewer/joinTies; snapshot.ts BOM and stray conflicted-copy names; atomic.ts fsync; remote.ts abort after failed COMMIT; fs-kind.ts fuseblk and synced-folder detection.

completion.releaseNote: Pulls keep unexported local edits; file-sync copies no longer block import; init and doctor warn about a database in a synced folder.
completion.summary: Commit 93a3628. joinTies merges by field stamps when DB and file diverged at any version. Snapshot reader drops a BOM and skips id-plus-text copies with a problem line. writeFileAtomic flushes before rename. Daemon answers abort/end for a finished transaction; client request limit 60 s. fuseblk local. syncedFolder by path; doctor fails a "synced folder" check, init warns. Not tested: flush; a real failed COMMIT.
